history.summary: A 2005 99LH 4BR at Whitewater in Pasir Ris (D18) for $1.63M / $1,202 psf, with a generous 1,356 sqft and a future Cross Island Line catalyst (CP2 Elias, ~820m). Low PSF and the CRL story are real positives, but no URA data, ~78yr lease, and a far-east location with abundant supply temper it.
history.rating_rationale: The CRL Punggol-extension station CP2 Elias (~820m, ~2032) is a genuine future-uplift catalyst, and $1,202 psf for a roomy 1,356 sqft family 4BR is an affordable, liquid OCR ticket at $1.63M. Against that: no URA appreciation/txn data in the dossier, a 2005 lease (~78yr left) decaying into resale, and Pasir Ris has heavy competing supply. Score_1000 414 reflects the mixed picture. Balances to Neutral with a watch on CRL progress.
red_flags: No URA appreciation/transaction data to anchor value
99LH 2005 — ~78yr lease, decay drag on a hold-and-resell
Far-east Pasir Ris with substantial competing/new supply
catalysts: Cross Island Line CP2 Elias station ~820m (future connectivity uplift)
Low $1,202 psf for a generous 1,356 sqft family 4BR — affordable, liquid quantum
Pasir Ris waterfront/Allapine Gardens master-plan rejuvenation
